mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM graduate g ) AS totalGraduates, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND er.destination IS NOT NULL AND er.destination != '待就业' ) AS employedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND er.destination IN ('升学') ) AS furtherStudyCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND er.destination IN ('创业') ) AS entrepreneurshipCount

SELECT d.id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND er.destination IS NOT NULL AND er.destination != '待就业' THEN g.id END) AS employed, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND er.destination IS NOT NULL AND er.destination != '待就业' THEN g.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) * 100, 2) END AS rate FROM department d LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN employment_record er ON er.graduate_id = g.id AND er.review_status = 'APPROVED'
d.status = 1
GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY rate DESC

SELECT er.destination AS destination, COUNT(1) AS count FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY er.destination ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(er.industry, '未知') AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY er.industry ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(er.company_type, '未知') AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED'
GROUP BY er.company_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(er.review_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(1) AS increment FROM employment_record er LEFT JOIN graduate g ON g.id = er.graduate_id WHERE er.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND er.review_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(er.review_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
